method: Off/on/off Vmid-between-channel control. Each capture has one-second warm-up and twelve-second measurement, all 50 normal ADC-ordered routes, 10 MHz blocking/manual/repeat1, reference 2.5 V, profile off. Existing firmware vmid command inserts two channel15 operations after every route; only sensor-route samples are retained.
hardware_state: Both sensor strips attached and reported unstressed by the user, GUI disconnected; laptop charger connected. One Vmid bias resistor per ADC at shared MXO/op-amp input.
limitations: Vmid insertion changes acquisition cadence, revisit time, analog MUX history and digital command pattern together. Sensor strips are attached and reported unstressed; mechanical and electrical stability were not independently instrumented. Vmid conversions are discarded by current firmware, not exported as raw reference samples.
